title: Connected TV Advertising: What It Is and Why It Matters

facts.fact: According to the page, 61% of households are subscribed to multiple streaming services, citing IAB Compass.
facts.quote: With 61% of households subscribed to multiple streaming services (IAB Compass), your audience is spread across all of these environments.

facts.fact: The page cites industry benchmarks showing CTV ads achieve 95%+ completion rates, compared with 20-40% on YouTube and under 30% on social video.
facts.quote: Industry benchmarks show CTV ads achieve 95%+ completion rates compared to 20-40% on YouTube and under 30% on social video.

facts.fact: The page states that 64% of marketers use first-party data for CTV targeting.
facts.quote: Today, 64% of marketers use first-party data for CTV targeting, while 60% apply behavioral or intent-based signals.

facts.fact: The page states that 50% of marketers cite audience targeting inefficiencies as their top CTV challenge.
facts.quote: That said, 50% of marketers cite audience targeting inefficiencies as their top CTV challenge.

facts.fact: Teads says its global taxonomy includes more than 300 omnichannel audience segments.
facts.quote: Through a global taxonomy of more than 300

facts.fact: Per Teads' 2025 CTV Pulse report, 24% of 18-24 year olds will scan a QR code and 15% will add products to a cart directly from a CTV ad.
facts.quote: 24% will scan a QR code, 15% will add products to a cart directly from an ad

facts.fact: Per Teads' 2025 CTV Pulse report, 14% of 25-34 year olds will add products to a cart from a CTV ad and 12% will scan a QR code.
facts.quote: 14% will add to cart, 12% will scan a QR code

facts.fact: EMARKETER reports that 71% of net new streaming subscriptions over the past nine quarters have been ad-supported.
facts.quote: 71% of net new streaming subscriptions over the past nine quarters have been ad-supported.

facts.fact: Half of large companies (250+ employees) always include CTV in their marketing strategy, compared with 6-7% of small businesses.
facts.quote: Half of large companies (250+ employees) now always include CTV in their marketing strategy, compared to just 6-7% of small businesses.

facts.fact: The page reports that 53% of marketing decision-makers would increase CTV spend with better ROI measurement.
facts.quote: CTV measurement is still catching up, with 53% of marketing decision-makers saying they would increase CTV spend with better ROI measurement.

facts.fact: The page reports that 45% of marketing decision-makers want improved attention metrics and 44% want cross-screen effectiveness tracking.
facts.quote: Another 45% want improved attention metrics, and 44% want cross-screen effectiveness tracking.

facts.fact: According to Teads benchmark data, campaigns optimized for attention deliver nearly three times the impact of those optimized for viewability alone.
facts.quote: Campaigns optimized for attention deliver nearly three times the impact of those optimized for viewability alone, according to Teads benchmark data.

facts.fact: Global Web Index data shows 69% of CTV viewers use their phone simultaneously.
facts.quote: Global Web Index data shows 69% use their phone simultaneously

facts.fact: Of CTV viewers using a phone simultaneously, 47% message friends, 41% scroll social media, and 48% read emails, per Global Web Index data.
facts.quote: messaging friends (47%), scrolling social media (41%), or reading emails (48%).

facts.fact: The page defines Connected TV as any television that connects to the internet to stream digital content, including smart TVs, external streaming devices, and gaming consoles.
facts.quote: Connected TV refers to any television that connects to the internet to stream digital content.
